title: ai-runs: consolidate its requirements under the cap, then answer its provider notices
prior_work: First, consolidate build/requirements/ai-runs.md (74111 bytes) under the requirements cap (70000): move non-requirement text (status history, rulings, cross-references, commentary) to docs/requirements-notes/ai-runs.md, which this job owns, and keep every **R<n>** and **F<n>** line and its mark verbatim; add a test under this module's tests that asserts the set of requirement ids and unmet marks in build/requirements/ai-runs.md is unchanged by the move (compare against the ids at the start commit). Then do the provider-notice work this START lists: for each notice, decide from your own requirements what this module must do, adapt or confirm, and add a test of your own for the change, failing with it reverted where code changes. Only if consolidation cannot get the file under the cap, stop and report to BOB with a split proposal (new module ids, build/modules.json rows, build/layers.md). Edit no other module, and commit no generated file (rows.mjs, words-unreviewed.json, any dist). Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead.

status.reason: Consolidation is done and pushed (fa6ab9d0): build/requirements/ai-runs.md is 69,520 bytes, under the 70,000 cap. Every R line and mark is kept; the moved text is in docs/requirements-notes/ai-runs.md, and requirements-ids.test.mjs passes. job complete cannot pass, though, because the ai-runs suite was already red at the start commit 9fa7b50f: 137 of 145 tests fail, before any change of mine. Every failure has one cause. ai-accounts' T53 rewrite removed the API ai-runs still calls: accountReferenceSet in test/m/ai-runs/world.mjs, plus accountReferenceState, groupKeyState, groupKeySwitches, accountUses({owner}) and accountFor's old {key} answer in src/ai-runs/index.mjs. ai-accounts is not one of this START's notices. Fixing it is this module's owed T53 work (R52, R93 and the rest of the 34 T53 marks), not consolidation or notices. Notice decisions: (1) credentials:74: only marks were struck and no code changed. aiRunCredentialMint and aiRunCredentialsEnd are unchanged, so ai-runs is confirmed with nothing to adapt. (2) membership:77: R154 changed tests only, and the delegates ai-runs imports are unchanged, so confirmed. (3) run-rules:72 needs code. partAdmittedOn now admits nothing outside a test instance without an entry_id and Gate 1 records (held.gateRecords). ai-runs.partAdmitted(part) passes neither, so every mode is refused C-109.1 on a real instance. R78 (T53) says partAdmitted(part, entry) reads the verdict ai-gate recorded, but there is no src/ai-gate. Whether Gate 1 records come from ai-catalogue's entry verdicts or wait for ai-gate is BOB's call. To unblock: restart ai-runs as its T53 job (adapt to ai-accounts T53, R52 and R93, and give partAdmitted its entry and gate-record source), with these three notices folded in.
